description: Synthetic, sanitized excerpts in the style of ASX announcements, news stories and public discussion posts, labelled with the content topics each discusses. Company names are placeholders. Used to evaluate the content topic rules; expected_topics lists every topic a careful reader would tag, and an empty list means none applies.

fixtures.title: Half Year Results for the period ended 31 December 2025
fixtures.text: The Company reported statutory net profit after tax of $412 million, up 8% on the prior corresponding period. Revenue increased 5% to $3.1 billion and underlying EBITDA rose to $890 million. The Board declared an interim dividend of 45 cents per share. The Company reaffirms its full year guidance.

fixtures.title: FY26 Guidance Update
fixtures.text: Following weaker than expected volumes in the third quarter, the Company now expects FY26 underlying EBITDA of $1.20 billion to $1.25 billion, compared with prior guidance of $1.35 billion to $1.40 billion. Lower wholesale prices and higher operating costs contributed to the downgrade.

fixtures.title: Miner lifts copper production guidance after strong quarter
fixtures.text: The miner raised its copper production guidance for the year to between 1.85 and 1.95 million tonnes after record output at its flagship operation. Analysts said the upgraded outlook supported revenue forecasts, although unit cost guidance was unchanged.

fixtures.title: Quarterly Activities Report
fixtures.text: Sales revenue for the quarter was $2.4 billion. Production of 46 million tonnes was in line with plan, and the Company remains on track to deliver full year production within guidance. Cash at the end of the quarter was $1.1 billion.

fixtures.title: Thoughts on the full year result?
fixtures.text: Pretty happy with the full year result. NPAT came in above consensus and the outlook for next year looks better than I expected. Margins held up even with wage pressure. Holding for now.

fixtures.title: Full Year Results Presentation
fixtures.text: Group revenue of $18.2 billion, up 3%. Underlying profit of $2.6 billion. Earnings per share of 212 cents. Operating margin improved 40 basis points as cost programs delivered savings.

fixtures.title: Class action update
fixtures.text: The Company refers to the shareholder class action filed in the Federal Court of Australia in 2024. The parties have agreed in principle to settle the proceedings for $45 million, subject to Court approval. The settlement is without admission of liability.

fixtures.title: Insurer faces lawsuit over denied flood claims
fixtures.text: A group of policyholders has filed a lawsuit in the Supreme Court of Queensland alleging the insurer wrongly denied flood claims. The plaintiffs are seeking damages and costs. The company said it would defend the proceedings.

fixtures.title: Outcome of appeal
fixtures.text: The Full Court of the Federal Court has dismissed the Company's appeal against the judgment delivered last year in the contract dispute with its former joint venture partner. The Company is considering whether to seek special leave to appeal to the High Court.

fixtures.title: Another class action incoming?
fixtures.text: Saw that a law firm is investigating a class action on behalf of shareholders who bought before the guidance cut. Anyone know how these usually play out for the share price? The last litigation took years.

fixtures.title: Retailer hit with injunction in trademark fight
fixtures.text: A judge granted an interim injunction preventing the retailer from selling its new house brand range while a trademark dispute is heard. The rival filed a statement of claim alleging the packaging was deceptively similar.

fixtures.title: Response to media speculation regarding legal proceedings
fixtures.text: The Company notes media reports regarding potential legal proceedings by a former contractor. No proceedings have been served on the Company. The Company will keep the market informed in accordance with its continuous disclosure obligations.

fixtures.title: ASIC commences civil penalty proceedings
fixtures.text: The Company has been notified that ASIC has commenced civil penalty proceedings in the Federal Court alleging breaches of the Corporations Act in relation to fees charged to customers. The Company is reviewing the claim and will respond in due course.

fixtures.title: ACCC opposes proposed supermarket acquisition
fixtures.text: The competition regulator said it would oppose the proposed acquisition, citing concerns that it would substantially lessen competition in several regional markets. The ACCC's decision follows a six-month review.

fixtures.title: APRA increases operational risk capital requirement
fixtures.text: APRA has informed the Bank that it will apply an additional $250 million operational risk capital overlay following a review of the Bank's risk governance. The Bank has entered into an enforceable undertaking to remediate identified weaknesses.

fixtures.title: FIRB approval received for acquisition
fixtures.text: The Company is pleased to advise that it has received approval from the Foreign Investment Review Board for its proposed acquisition. Completion remains subject to the remaining conditions precedent.

fixtures.title: State government raises coal royalty rates
fixtures.text: The state government will introduce new royalty tiers from July, lifting the top rate for coal sold above $300 a tonne. Producers warned the legislation would hurt investment.
AUSTRAC filing against the casino operator is brutal reading. Compliance failures across years. Expect a big penalty.

fixtures.title: Company launches next-generation cochlear implant
fixtures.text: The Company today announced the launch of its next-generation implant system, which will be available to customers in Australia and Europe from next month. The new product offers improved battery life and connectivity.

fixtures.title: Telco unveils new satellite messaging service
fixtures.text: The telco unveiled a new service letting customers send text messages via satellite in areas without mobile coverage. The rollout begins on selected handsets this quarter.

fixtures.title: First production at lithium project
fixtures.text: The Company is pleased to announce first production of spodumene concentrate at its lithium project, marking the transition from construction to operations. The first cargo is expected to ship next quarter.

fixtures.title: New app launch is actually good
fixtures.text: Just tried the bank's new app that launched this week. The budgeting tools are a big step up. Curious whether it moves the needle on customer numbers.

fixtures.title: TGA approval and commercial release of new plasma therapy
fixtures.text: The Company has received TGA approval for its new plasma therapy and will begin commercial release to Australian hospitals in March. Commercialisation in the United States remains subject to FDA review.

fixtures.title: Retailer to roll out new store format nationally
fixtures.text: The retailer will roll out its new smaller store format across 40 sites after a successful trial in Melbourne. The format focuses on convenience and online order collection.

fixtures.title: Banks brace for slower loan growth as RBA holds cash rate
fixtures.text: The Reserve Bank held the cash rate at 4.1% and signalled interest rates would stay higher for longer to contain inflation. Bank analysts said slower credit growth would weigh on net interest margins.

fixtures.title: Quarterly production report
fixtures.text: Realised iron ore prices fell 12% in the quarter as Chinese demand softened. The Company notes ongoing uncertainty from tariffs on steel exports. Full year production guidance is unchanged.

fixtures.title: Weaker Australian dollar boosts exporters
fixtures.text: The Australian dollar fell below 62 US cents, a move that lifts the earnings of exporters who sell in US dollars. Miners and agricultural producers are among the biggest beneficiaries of the lower exchange rate.

fixtures.title: Cost of living squeeze hitting discretionary retail
fixtures.text: Consumer demand for big-ticket items seems to be falling off a cliff. With the cost of living where it is, I can't see discretionary retailers doing well this half.

fixtures.title: Update on exposure to Middle East shipping disruption
fixtures.text: The Company advises that geopolitical tensions in the Red Sea have disrupted shipping routes, increasing freight costs and delivery times. Sanctions on certain counterparties have not affected the Company's contracts.

fixtures.title: Oil price slide weighs on energy producers
fixtures.text: Brent crude fell 6% this week as fears of a global recession grew, dragging down shares of energy producers. A lower oil price reduces revenue for LNG exporters whose contracts are linked to crude.

fixtures.title: Results of Meeting
fixtures.text: In accordance with Listing Rule 3.13.2, the Company advises the results of the Annual General Meeting. All resolutions were decided by poll and passed.

fixtures.title: Application for quotation of securities
fixtures.text: The entity applies for quotation of 125,000 fully paid ordinary shares issued under its employee incentive plan.

fixtures.title: Appointment of Chief Financial Officer
fixtures.text: The Company announces the appointment of a new Chief Financial Officer, effective 1 March. She joins from a global consumer goods company where she held senior finance roles.

fixtures.title: Which broker do you all use?
fixtures.text: Looking to move off my current broker. Fees are too high. Any recommendations for something cheap with a decent app?

fixtures.title: Change of Director's Interest Notice
fixtures.text: Notice is given of a change in the relevant interests of a director. The director acquired 10,000 ordinary shares on market.
Lovely day at the beach. Markets can wait.

fixtures.title: Dividend reinvestment plan pricing
fixtures.text: The DRP price for the interim dividend has been determined as $24.15, being the average of the daily volume weighted average market price over the pricing period.

fixtures.title: Notice of Annual General Meeting
fixtures.text: Notice is given that the Annual General Meeting of shareholders will be held on 24 October. Voting instructions and the proxy form are enclosed.
